    for r in range(rows):
        row_start = first_i if r == 0 else (first_i + 1) % n
        for c in range(cols):

    """Fill zeros in a cyclic grid where each row inserts a diagonal repeat."""
    if not grid:
        return []
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cycle = sorted({value for row in grid for value in row if value != 0})
    n = len(cycle)
    base = cycle.index(grid[0][0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(rows):
        start = base if r == 0 else (base + 1) % n
        for c in range(cols):
            # Every lower row starts at the next color and repeats its
            # preceding color at the diagonal, shifting its remaining suffix.
            offset = c if r == 0 or c < r else c - 1
            value = cycle[(start + offset) % n]
            if out[r][c] == 0:
                out[r][c] = value
    return out
